title: A broad commodity-price impulse (energy, grains, sugar, copper) as a lead for spot gold

rule.basket: equal-weight mean of weekly log returns of wtico, bco, natgas, corn, wheat, soybn, sugar, xcu
rule.entry: next gold daily open, held 20 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: basket month impulse (4 weeks) beyond 1 sd: gold the same way for the next 20 candles (primary)
basket month move gold did not follow (residual on gold, 4 weeks) beyond 1 sd: gold the same way
basket quarter impulse (13 weeks) beyond 1 sd: gold the same way for the next 20 candles
